title: Testimonial · avatar + quote
description: Directly under a hero or a product claim to add a human voice. Max one per email.
usage: Single named patient quote with circular portrait. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Transparent PNG, circle-masked portrait (lavender backdrop), contain.
Same portrait at 64px, shown on mobile via mfs-show.

notes: Portrait and quote stay side by side on mobile, as in the Mobile frame; the portrait shrinks 100 → 64px by swapping images (mfs-hide / mfs-show). Replace both when swapping the portrait.
The portrait PNG carries its own circular mask, so it stays round in Outlook.
Mobile right padding is 40px instead of Figma's 32px: the left gutter and gap scale with mfs-px3, but the quote's 24px right padding is fixed (no padding-right utility).
